function.description: Return the whole scene summary again (objects, selection, stock, joints). Lengths are in mm.
function.name: get_scene

function.description: Search objects by name, tag, material, kind (group/component) or id. Use when the scene summary was truncated.
function.name: find_objects

function.description: Details of one entity, including its faces (id, normal, center, area) for push_pull. Face normals point out of the part; a positive push_pull distance moves a face outward.
function.name: get_object

function.description: Entities currently selected in the editor.
function.name: get_selection

function.description: Stock materials that can be assigned to boards.
function.name: list_stock_materials

function.description: Create one rectangular board as a named group. origin_mm is the minimum corner; size_mm is [x, y, z] extents. Prefer this over drawing.
function.name: create_board

function.description: Copy an object or group, shifted by offset_mm. Returns the new ids.
function.name: create_copy

function.description: Draw loose connected edges through points; a closed loop makes a face. Not grouped.
function.name: draw_polyline

function.description: Translate objects by delta_mm.
function.name: move

function.description: Rotate objects about an axis through pivot_mm.
function.name: rotate

function.description: Uniformly scale objects about center_mm.
function.name: scale

function.description: Resize a board to size_mm (world-axis extents), keeping its minimum corner fixed.
function.name: resize_board

function.description: Extrude a face outward by distance_mm (see get_object for face ids). Negative cuts into the part.
function.name: push_pull

function.description: Rename an object.
function.name: rename

function.description: Assign a stock material to objects, or null to clear.
function.name: set_material

function.description: Set the grain direction of an object along a world axis, or null to clear.
function.name: set_grain

function.description: Group objects, or make them a component (linked copies). Member ids change; see the result.
function.name: group

function.description: Dissolve groups/components one level.
function.name: ungroup

function.description: Assign a tag by name (created if missing), or null to clear.
function.name: tag

function.description: Paint objects or faces with an RGB color.
function.name: paint

function.description: Delete entities.
function.name: erase

function.description: Add a wood joint between two boards. The boards must already overlap where they meet (the overlap sets the joint depth). Optional params tune the joint (ratios 0-1, clearance in mm).
function.name: add_joint

function.description: Add a dimension annotation between two points, drawn offset_mm away.
function.name: add_dimension

function.description: Add a text note anchored at point_mm.
function.name: add_text

function.description: Select entities in the editor so the designer sees them.
function.name: select

function.description: Open a group/component for editing its inner parts.
function.name: enter_object

function.description: Leave any open group and edit the top level again.
function.name: exit_to_root
